title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten distinct, named destinations on campus-adjacent Ada corridors, each with a directly sourced reason to stop.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor • 530 S Main St
cards.notes: Use this South Main stop when you need a food option near ONU’s front edge; the official locator lists this Ada restaurant and its address.
cards.short_summary: A chain-food stop on the campus-facing end of South Main.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists an Ada location at 530 South Main Street.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Ada, OH
cards.access_notes: Check the official store page for current hours and service options.

cards.title: Starbucks at ONU
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor • 534 S Main St
cards.notes: Make this a campus-edge coffee or snack stop; the county tourism office identifies Starbucks at 534 South Main Street on the ONU campus.
cards.short_summary: A Starbucks location at ONU’s South Main entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: Hardin County’s tourism page identifies Starbucks at 534 South Main Street and says it is located at the Ohio Northern University campus.
cards.source_title: Places to Sip | Hardin County Chamber & Business Alliance
cards.access_notes: Confirm current store hours through Starbucks before going.

cards.title: Subway
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor • Ada
cards.notes: Use the official Ada location listing to confirm service before walking over; it provides a straightforward sandwich-and-salad option on South Main.
cards.short_summary: An Ada Subway location on the South Main corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway’s official locator lists a location in Ada, Ohio.
cards.access_notes: Use Subway’s official locator for the current address, hours, and ordering options.

cards.title: Ada Padrone's
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor • 219 S Main St
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s live menu before heading north on Main; its official page lists online ordering and the Ada street address.
cards.short_summary: A pizza restaurant on the downtown stretch of South Main.
cards.evidence_claim: Ada Padrone’s official page lists the restaurant at 219 S Main Street in Ada and provides its menu and ordering link.
cards.access_notes: The official page shows current ordering information; verify availability before visiting.

cards.title: Ada Theatre
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor • 215 S Main St
cards.notes: Look up the current film and showtime, then walk to this downtown Main Street theater; its official site posts the schedule and ticket information.
cards.short_summary: A single-screen movie theater in downtown Ada.
cards.evidence_claim: Ada Theatre’s official site lists its location at 215 S Main Street in Ada and posts current films and showtimes.
cards.access_notes: Check the theater’s official page for the current film, showtime, and ticket details.

cards.title: El Campo Mexican Restaurant
cards.subtitle: North Main Street corridor • 204 N Main St
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s contact page to check hours or arrange takeout before going; it gives the North Main address and reservation option.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican restaurant just north of the downtown Main intersection.
cards.evidence_claim: El Campo Mexican Restaurant’s official contact page lists 204 N Main Street, Ada, and says takeout is available.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists current hours; check it before visiting or placing a takeout order.

cards.title: Ada Public Library
cards.subtitle: North Main Street corridor • 320 N Main St
cards.notes: Bring a book, use library resources, or check the program calendar at this North Main public library; its contact page lists address and hours.
cards.short_summary: A public-library stop farther up North Main.
cards.evidence_claim: Ada Public Library lists its address as 320 N Main Street and publishes its weekly hours.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by day; verify them on the library’s official contact page.

cards.title: Village of Ada Offices
cards.subtitle: West Buckeye Avenue corridor • 115 W Buckeye Ave
cards.notes: Stop here for village-government information or use the official site to locate public notices; the office sits one block west of downtown Main.
cards.short_summary: The municipal office on the westbound Buckeye corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Village of Ada’s official website lists its address as 115 West Buckeye Avenue in Ada.
cards.access_notes: Use the Village website for current office notices and contact information.

cards.title: Ada Depot Railroad Park
cards.subtitle: East Central Avenue corridor • beside Central Avenue
cards.notes: Walk the Central Avenue side of downtown to see the depot park; a Village council record identifies Central Avenue directly south of the park.
cards.short_summary: A named depot park beside the East Central corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: A Village of Ada council record refers to a portion of Central Avenue directly south of Depot Railroad Park and its parking lot.
cards.source_title: Village of Ada Council Meeting Record
cards.access_notes: This is an outdoor public-space stop; observe any posted park or event restrictions.

cards.title: Wilson Ada Football Factory
cards.subtitle: East Highland Avenue corridor • 517 E Highland Ave
cards.notes: Book a factory tour or visit the retail store and small museum; Wilson’s Ada page describes all three and gives the East Highland location.
cards.short_summary: A football-making factory with tours, retail, and a small museum.
cards.evidence_claim: Wilson says its Ada factory offers bookable tours, a retail store, and a small museum at 517 E Highland Avenue.
cards.source_title: Ada, Ohio Football Factory | Wilson Sporting Goods
cards.access_notes: Tours require online booking; Wilson lists factory hours separately from tour availability.
